title: Shingeki no Craft :- Recepies Addon
description: This Project Adds recepies of some uncraftable items from Shingeki no Craft in minecraft
body:
**SNC Recipes Addon**

Expand your SNC gameplay with a collection of carefully balanced crafting recipes designed to make special items more accessible through survival progression. This addon adds recipes for various SNC-exclusive items, including special masks, titan-related artifacts, toys, totems, weapons, gear components, music discs, and utility items.

### Features

* New crafting recipes for SNC special items.
* Craftable titan masks and shifter-related items.
* Additional recipes for ODM gear components and equipment.
* Recipes for special totems, invitations, toys, and collectibles.
* Craftable utility items such as wrenches, jars, and other miscellaneous tools.
* Survival-friendly progression without requiring commands.
* Lightweight and fully focused on recipe additions.

Perfect for players who want easier access to SNC content while maintaining a balanced survival experience. Whether you're collecting rare items, experimenting with titan powers, or building your arsenal, this addon provides convenient ways to obtain many SNC-exclusive items through crafting.
